The companies behind the robots

Our sponsors

Everything the team builds is paid for by somebody. These are the companies whose money, parts, and software make a season possible — and the levels they support us at.

Thank you

The people who make it possible

Four levels, from a hundred dollars to five thousand and up. Every one of them ends up on a robot, in a lab, or on a trailer heading to a competition.

Platinum

$5,000 and above

Large logo on the competition robot, on every banner we travel with, and an appreciation plaque.

This level is open. Be the first to support us here

Gold

$1,000 – $4,999

Medium logo on the competition robot, and on the banners we take to competitions and events.

  • SolidWorks
  • Knecht Home Center

Silver

$500 – $999

Small logo on the competition robot for the year, in front of every team we compete against.

This level is open. Be the first to support us here

Bronze

$100 – $499

Logo on this page, and updates on the team and its competitions twice a year.

  • Polymaker
And everyone else

Support that does not fit a level

We are a student organization and a non-profit, so the team runs on school funding, fundraisers, and outside help. A box of filament, a length of aluminum, or an afternoon on somebody's machine keeps a build moving just as surely as a check does.

We are part of the South Dakota Mines CAMP program, and we thank them for their support.

Put your name on the robot

Support starts at $100, and every level puts a company in front of the students, schools, and teams we meet at national competitions. Tell us what you have in mind and we will send you the details.
